records.canonicalQuestion: How do I change Mark Up Report grand total in Playwright without editing Total Perimeter?
alternateQuestions: Which pricing field should PG e2e bump to move grand total reliably?
records.shortAnswer: Broad div.filter on Mark Up Report matches wrong inputs (Total Perimeter instead of Subcontractor Cost). Use getByText(label) + ancestor div xpath for number input. Prefer Subcontractor Cost +$5000 under Outside Costs.
records.detailedAnswer: Playwright Mark Up Report currency field locators

records.canonicalQuestion: Why does Proposal Generator Mark Up Report show wrong total after reload when server pricing changed?
alternateQuestions: What gate proves estimator-trust closure beyond infrastructure smokes?
records.shortAnswer: Production 360 Power: server editable-workspace holds edited grand ($10,957.94) but Mark Up UI and preview cover re-hydrate to $0 or door-only $5,545.44 after reload. Client persist does not converge (workspaceSynced false). Do not declare app closed on infra smokes alone.

records.canonicalQuestion: Why does Proposal Generator pricing not save to editable-workspace on expired pilot?
alternateQuestions: What is workspaceSynced and why does it block client persist in PG?
records.shortAnswer: On 360 Power production pilot, Mark Up edits do not persist to proposal-editable-workspace within 30s because canPersistWorkspacePayload requires workspaceSynced === true. E2e uses authorized server-sync PUT as test-only fallback.
records.detailedAnswer: workspaceSynced gate blocks client pricing persist on expired pilot
